title: ci: verify on a pr waits for the owner's environment approval

decisions.title: The heavy PR checks run only once the owner approves them (environment review)
Environment gate on verify, cheap blackbox job free, one approval per PR through concurrency cancellation
The approval applies to the release PR only, not to every PR
Gate withdrawn: after #807 the release PR runs nothing of its own; concurrency dedupe kept
Long-lived PRs (release, Version Packages) run their checks only when approved; feature PRs run at once
Environment gate scoped to long-lived PR heads (dev, changeset-release/*); PR runs restored for the release PR
